title: Daily briefing: Landmark bat study suggests they evolved in Europe
title_zh: 每日简报：突破性蝙蝠研究表明它们在欧洲进化
abstract: A new project aims to generate chromosome-level genomes for all living bat species. Plus, AlphaFold has a new pandemic preparedness portal and security risks of AI.
abstract_zh: 一项新计划旨在为所有现存蝙蝠物种生成染色体级基因组。此外，AlphaFold推出了新的大流行预警门户，并讨论了人工智能的安全风险。
snippet: A new project aims to generate chromosome-level genomes for all living bat species. Plus, AlphaFold has a new pandemic preparedness portal and security risks of AI.
